name: finpilot
description: FinPilot — privacy-first personal financial intelligence platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finpilot/api" "npm run dev -w @finpilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @finpilot/api && npm run build -w @finpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
